name: Feature upgrade diagnostic report
packageArguments: Optional: {"Section":"Summary"}, or Rollback, Servicing, Setup, Boot, Maintenance. Base64 in PackageArguments. Each read-only stdout JSON report is at most 8000 UTF-8 bytes; no custom field writes. Maintenance reads exact maintenance guard inputs: numeric OS build/UBR/InstallDate, Setup and MoSetup state (unknown value names only), allowlisted ImageState from the fixed Setup\State\State.ini and Setup State registry key with missing/unavailable/unknown statuses, at most eight Source OS prior-build keys, boot, pending-reboot booleans and rename entry count with four sanitized paths, staging directory creation metadata, native-marker existence, bounded allowlisted legacy upgrade state, and at most 20 setup/servicing processes with PID/creation/CPU time. No command lines, arbitrary registry values, setup logs, mutations or guard overrides. Five-second CIM requests and the existing 40-second section-start budget apply. Truncation and unavailable evidence remain explicit.
